scenario: A bare (un-negated) integer literal 9223372036854775808 = 2^63 is one past INT64_MAX and is a range error per LGRA.2.7.3, even though `-9223372036854775808` (INT64_MIN) is valid (LGRA.2.7.3b). Confirms the INT64_MIN admission does not leak into the positive range.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v > 9223372036854775808
->
    log info "x"
